items.title: Dust & Iron (Short Film)
items.logline: A lone courier crosses an empty stretch of coastline at dusk to deliver a locked tin box, unaware he is being tracked from the ridge.

items.title: The Last Ferry Out — Extract
items.logline: Two estranged brothers wait out a winter storm in a Kent harbour office as the final mainland crossing is cancelled.
items.scriptExcerpt:
EXT. HARBOUR WALL - NIGHT

Rain lashes the concrete pier in sideways sheets. CALLUM (19) pulls his collar tight, staring out into the pitch black of the Channel.

                    CALLUM
          She's not coming back out in this.

                    DANNY (O.S.)
          Keep watching the channel marker. You'll
          see the bow lights before you hear the
          engine.
